gloss: cultural level (of a people); civic manners

definitions.gloss: the cultural level or civic manners of a people
definitions.explanation: How cultured, well-mannered and public-spirited the people of a country or community are, judged by how they behave in public.

examples.japanese: {民度|みんど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。

⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ごみ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拾|ひろ}う→拾う：00845_hirou⟧⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧、{民度|みんど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}さ→高さ：05327_takasa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: Seeing the spectators picking up rubbish after the match, I was struck by how civic-minded they were.

examples.japanese: ⟦{他国|たこく}→他国：28893_takoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{民度|みんど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{決|き}めつける→決めつける：13267_kimetsukeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{失礼|しつれい}→失礼：01247_shitsurei⟧だ。
examples.english: It is rude to decide that another country's people are uncivilized.

notes:
Almost always with ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ or ⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧. The word judges a whole group, so {民度|みんど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧ is a sweeping and often offensive remark; it is common in online arguments.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {民度|みんど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ / ⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: civic-minded / uncivilized
- {民度|みんど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}さ→高さ：05327_takasa⟧: how civic-minded people are
